entities.name: Fire Hydrant (IoT device)
entities.rationale: Pink fire hydrant drawing on the left side of the whiteboard; acts as the IoT/sensor data source that sends data to API Gateway. Not inside any box or container.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled 'API GATEWAY' (AWS_Icon_4 at 838,314). Standalone, no containing box. Receives the arrow from the hydrant and has an arrow to S3.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3' (AWS_Icon_5 at 1011,313). Standalone, no containing box. Receives arrow from API Gateway and has an arrow going down to ECS.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'ECS' (AWS_Icon_2 at 1022,548). Standalone, no containing box. Receives arrow from S3 and has an arrow to SageMaker.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: Teal icon labeled 'SAGEMAKER' (AWS_Icon_1 at 1193,557). Standalone, no containing box. Receives arrow from ECS.

entities.name: Analyst
entities.rationale: Pink person figure labeled 'ANALYST' at top right (AWS_Icon_6 and AWS_Icon_3 at ~1358,248-295 are the head and body of this figure). Not inside any box; no line drawn to or from it in this frame.

visual_connections.description: Green curved arrow rising from the top of the hydrant and ending with an arrowhead at the top of the API Gateway icon.
Green curved arrow arching over the top from API Gateway to the top of the S3 icon.
Green curved arrow starting below the S3 icon, curving down and left, ending with an arrowhead at the left side of the ECS icon.
Green curved arrow arching over the top from ECS to the top of the SageMaker icon.
